facts.business: DreamFolks Services Limited is India's leading travel and lifestyle experiences company, providing access to services such as private club membership, global airport lounges, railway lounges, golf lessons and games, meet & assist, airport transfers, spa & wellness, F&B, travel SIMs, beauty and grooming, and highway dining, among others, using its in-house proprietary technology platform for clients such as banks, card networks, airlines, OTAs, and enterprises.

auditor.name: S S Kothari Mehta & Co. LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter regarding a petition filed on May 15, 2026, under Section 9 of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 by Travel Food Services Limited, an operational creditor, before the National Company Law Tribunal, New Delhi Branch, alleging default in payment and seeking initiation of Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) against the Company for an amount aggregating to approximately INR 114.00 million. The management has represented that the Company strongly disputes the aforesaid claims and has taken appropriate legal steps, and appropriate provisions have already been made in the books of account and the matter is not indicative of any financial stress affecting the going concern status of the Company.

facts.related_party_note: The Company is in compliance with Sections 177 and 188 of the Act where applicable, for all transactions with the related parties and the details of related party transactions have been disclosed in the standalone financial statements as required by the applicable Indian Accounting Standards.
